$schema_note: STEP2 ownership source of truth for banxe-emi-stack (repo-scope only, ADR-117). .github/CODEOWNERS is GENERATED from this file by scripts/gitnexus/gen_codeowners.py — never hand-edit both. Fleet-level counterpart: banxe-architecture config/gitnexus/org-path-ownership.map.yaml (STEP4 merges them).

freshness.policy: Fable 5 hard rule: a stale map is more dangerous than no map. CI (codeowners-coverage) emits a warning once review_by is past; the quarterly review re-stamps both dates. Staleness never hard-fails merges (I-27: humans decide), it surfaces.

identity_note: USER-OWNED repo (no org): GitHub CODEOWNERS enforces only collaborators with write access — today that is exactly @CarmiBanxe. Role fields are OPERATOR-BINDING-REQUIRED placeholders: when the org/teams exist, bind each role to a real team and regenerate. Previous CODEOWNERS pointed at @mmber — an unrelated non-collaborator account (8 errors in GitHub codeowners API) — every rule was silently non-functional.

zones.role: CTIO + Compliance Officer (EU AI Act Art.14) (operator-binding-required)

extension_points.step3_scip: per-zone key `scip_index: true` will opt zones into symbol indexing granularity
extension_points.step4_fleet_graph: zones[].zone names are the join key to banxe-architecture org-path-ownership departments; fleet builder consumes both maps read-only
extension_points.step8_merge_queue: criticality feeds the merge-time impact gate thresholds (CRITICAL -> owner ack required)
extension_points.step3_scip_status: POPULATED by STEP3 — see top-level `scip` block and zones[].scip_index
extension_points.step4_fleet_graph_status: POPULATED by STEP4 — see fleet_graph block; STEP7 MCP serves fleet-graph-db read-only
extension_points.step5_contract_status: POPULATED by PASS A — see contract_gate block; STEP9 (Pact/schemathesis) builds on the same baseline
extension_points.step6_sbom_status: POPULATED by PASS A — see sbom block; Dependency-Track activation is an operator infra step

artifact_contract.name: scip-<slug>
artifact_contract.no_mock_rule: indexer failure => status UNKNOWN + visible warning; an empty/absent index is NEVER published as OK

fleet_graph.builder: scripts/gitnexus/build_fleet_graph.py — single-writer: exactly one CI builder job (concurrency group fleet-graph-<ref>), fresh DB per run, never merged into an old one

freshness_slo.stale_behavior: degrade to structural impact (scripts/gitnexus/detect_impact.py, PHASE1) + human ack — never blind-block, never silent-pass
freshness_slo.note: SLO enforcement activates at STEP7/STEP8 when a canonical main DB is consumed across runs; per-PR DBs are same-commit by construction

impact_gate.cross_zone_rule: any impacted zone outside the changed zones => ack-required
impact_gate.unknown_rule: changed file's target UNKNOWN => verdict UNKNOWN (fail-closed-visible, NO-MOCK)

contract_gate.no_mock_rule: spec-generation or oasdiff failure => UNKNOWN, gate fails visibly — never a silent pass; empty tool output from a failed run is never 'no breaking changes'
contract_gate.refresh_policy: baseline refresh is INTENTIONAL ONLY via contract_check.py --refresh-baseline, committed together with the API change + ack label; CI never auto-refreshes (see canon STEP5-6)

sbom.no_mock_rule: SBOM with 0 components = tool failure => FAIL, never a clean bill
sbom.dependency_track: OPTIONAL: uploads only when operator secrets DT_API_KEY + DT_URL are set; absent => documented degrade-to-skip SUCCESS (artifacts still produced)
